summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload at install time
details: Package advertises itself as a Vue 2 UI component library but ships an obfuscated preinstall script (setup.mjs) that, on npm install, downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases, extracts it to a temp directory, marks it executable, and uses it to execute a sibling file math_init.js at the package root. math_init.js is a 727KB heavily obfuscated JavaScript file (string-array rotation, large numeric/string dictionary, hex-named globals, decoder function) undocumented in the README. setup.mjs itself is obfuscated with hex-mangled identifiers hiding fs, https, execFileSync, readFileSync('/etc/os-release'), and ldd --version calls used to detect glibc vs musl and pick the matching Bun archive. The combination of an alternate runtime pulled in solely to execute an opaque sibling payload, obfuscation of both the loader and the payload, and no build/UI-library justification for either matches the alternate-runtime dropper pattern: the executed code path is fully controlled by the package author on every install and is designed to evade Node-based static analysis.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
